arcdamage.def: Damage of the Arc type from any source (weapons or abilities). Some weapon perks charge or trigger when you deal or receive it.
arcdamage.q: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils.

voiddamage.def: Damage of the Void type from any source (weapons or abilities). Some weapon perks trigger on Void final blows.
voiddamage.q: Multikills with Void damage immediately reload this weapon from reserves.

stasisdamage.def: Damage of the Stasis type from any source (weapons or abilities). Some weapon perks trigger on Stasis final blows.
stasisdamage.q: Stasis final blows transfer ammo to this weapon's magazine from reserves.
